# Boundless

Use `boundless/<model>` with VoltAgent's model router.

## Quick start

```ts
import { Agent } from "@voltagent/core";

const agent = new Agent({
  name: "boundless-agent",
  instructions: "You are a helpful assistant",
  model: "boundless/claude-fable-5.1",
});
```

## Environment variables

- `BOUNDLESS_API_KEY`

## Provider package

`@ai-sdk/openai-compatible`

This provider uses the OpenAI-compatible adapter.

## Default base URL

`https://api.inference.boundless.network/v1`

You can override the base URL by setting `BOUNDLESS_BASE_URL`.

- https://inference.boundless.network/models
